name: Grimmory
description: Grimmory is a self-hosted, multi-user library for ebooks, comics and audiobooks, continuing the BookLore project. It organizes books into libraries and smart shelves, fetches metadata automatically, and includes a web reader for EPUB, PDF and comics with annotations. Kobo and KOReader sync, OPDS and BookDrop imports are built in.

notes.text: The first visit to the web UI asks you to create the admin account.
Point libraries at folders under `/opt/grimmory_data/books`, or mount your book share into the container.
